note: Receptionist answers — the questions every HYROX coach gets asked, answered instantly in the Ask section. Tokenised; reskin-tenant substitutes coach/brand per tenant. Anything unmatched still goes to the coach's inbox.

items.q: I've never done HYROX — can I join?
items.a: Yes — that's most people who sign up. Josh builds you up from base fitness: technique on the stations first, then race-pace work. Nobody starts as a racer.

8km of running split by 8 workout stations — SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jumps, rowing, farmers carry, sandbag lunges and wall balls. Same format worldwide, so your time compares globally.
Bewdley-based — exact location and session times go out with the cohort announcements. Leave your email and you'll get the details directly.
Confirmed dates are on the race planner and events pages — updated the day HYROX announces them. Join the list and race-weekend plans land in your inbox.

items.q: How do I join a sim day?
items.a: Sim days get announced on the events page and to the email list first — they fill fast. Leave your email here and you'll hear before public announcement.

items.q: Can you find me a doubles partner?
items.a: That's literally what the find-a-partner page is for — post your target division and pace, and Josh's community matches people up. Free to use.

items.q: What training options and prices are available?
items.a: 1-1 Online Coaching — £180/month; HYROX 365 — £50/month; 12 Week HYROX Plan 1.0 — £60 one-off; Hybrid Performance — £19.99/month. Read the Coaching page for each offer's format and its official link. The provider sets current prices and terms.
Choose the offer that fits your goal on the Coaching page, then follow its own official button. Use Ask if you want to discuss your starting point first.

items.q: Where are the partner links and codes?
items.a: The Partners page lists Hybrid Hub clothing, Gymshark, Myprotein, adidas training. Check the linked provider for current eligibility and terms.
